featured.label: Wearable interfaces
featured.title: Learning personalized haptic perception
featured.fullTitle: A wearable input/output interface learns personalized models of haptic perception.
featured.authors: Wen Li, E. Adam, Z. Xu, J. Yao, A. Esmer, X. Ni, Bozhi Tian, Pedro Lopes
featured.description: A wearable input/output interface uses Bayesian learning to model and render individual tactile and thermal percepts, with applications in VR, sensory substitution, and haptic-guided robot teleoperation.
featured.imageAlt: Wearable haptic input/output device with an electrode array on the forearm.

featured.label: Haptic perception
featured.title: Electrotactile Improves Thermal Referral
featured.authors: Wen Li, Rong Ni, Bozhi Tian, Pedro Lopes
featured.description: Redirecting thermal sensations to skin locations without thermal actuators by combining electrotactile stimulation with thermal referral.
featured.imageAlt: Study illustration comparing vibrotactile and electrotactile thermal referral in VR.
